convenience_store_steps:
1. Go to the nearest Indomaret/Alfamart cashier
2. Provide Biller Code and Bill Key to the cashier
3. Cashier will process the payment
4. Pay according to the displayed amount
5. Keep the payment receipt as proof
payment_notes:
• Payment must be made before the time limit expires
• Tickets will be sent to your email after successful payment
• Keep your payment receipt for verification purposes
• Contact customer service if you experience any issues

bank_transfer_steps:
1. Open your mobile banking or internet banking app
2. Select Transfer or Payment menu
3. Select Virtual Account or VA
4. Enter the VA number above
5. Enter payment amount
6. Follow the next instructions
7. Save payment receipt
